name: pyne
description: Syntax highlighting, diagnostics, autocomplete, hover, and formatting for .pyne / .pine sources. Powered by hoox-pyne. Part of the HOOX open trading stack. Unofficial — not affiliated with TradingView, Inc.

pynescript.syntaxHighlighting.markdownDescription: Pine token palette for the TextMate grammar and language-server semantic tokens. Independent of `#pynescript.theme#`; select `none` to inherit the active theme's colors.
enumDescriptions: None — inherit the active theme's Pine colors.
AXIS Void — periwinkle and grey tokens.
Hoox Signal — signal-orange and grey tokens.
PYNE Volt — lime and grey tokens.

pynescript.lsp.enabled.description: Start the PYNE language server for Pine files. Turn this off to keep only syntax highlighting, snippets, and themes.

pynescript.lsp.command.markdownDescription: How to launch `pyne-lsp`. `auto` tries `pyne-lsp`, then `pynescript-lsp` on `PATH`, then `python -m pynescript.langserver`. Use an absolute path for a custom binary, or `docker` to run the GHCR image with `#pynescript.lsp.args#`. `${workspaceFolder}` is expanded.

pynescript.lsp.python.markdownDescription: Python interpreter used by `auto` when no `pyne-lsp` or `pynescript-lsp` executable is on `PATH`. It must have `pip install "hoox-pyne[lsp]"`.

pynescript.lsp.args.markdownDescription: Extra arguments appended to the language server process. With `"docker"`, these are the `docker run` arguments.

pynescript.formatting.enabled.description: Enable document formatting — full document, selection, and on-type — from the language server.

pynescript.formatOnSave.enabled.markdownDescription: Format Pine files when saving. Requires `#pynescript.formatting.enabled#`.

pynescript.diagnostics.enabled.description: Show errors, warnings, and hints from the language server.

pynescript.diagnostics.severity.markdownDescription: Remap diagnostic severity by lint-code prefix, e.g. `{"W": "Hint"}` renders `W001`-style warnings as hints. Allowed values: `Error`, `Warning`, `Information`, `Hint`.

pynescript.diagnostics.style.description: Show style-only findings (C001 naming, C002 line length, C004 trailing newline). Correctness diagnostics are always shown when diagnostics are enabled.

pynescript.diagnostics.semantic.description: Enable opt-in semantic checks: unknown fields/methods on user types, unknown enum members, and user-function argument mismatches. Off by default so incomplete edits never produce speculative errors.

pynescript.completion.snippets.description: Include snippets for builtin functions and declarations in autocomplete.

pynescript.hover.enabled.description: Show hover cards with signatures, documentation, and type information.

pynescript.inlayHints.parameters.description: Show parameter-name hints in function calls.

pynescript.signatureHelp.enabled.description: Show parameter hints while typing function arguments.

pynescript.semanticTokens.enabled.description: Colorize identifiers by semantic type (namespace, function, variable, keyword, …) from language-server tokens.

pynescript.documentHighlight.enabled.description: Highlight other occurrences of the identifier under the cursor.

pynescript.linkedEditing.enabled.markdownDescription: Rename matching identifiers as you type. Also requires the editor setting `editor.linkedEditing`.

pynescript.selectionRange.enabled.description: Enable smart expand/shrink selection around the cursor.

pynescript.documentLink.enabled.description: Make http(s) URLs in comments and strings clickable.

pynescript.codeAction.enabled.markdownDescription: Offer code actions such as **Convert to Pine v6** and the `W001` quick fix.

pynescript.install.autoInstall.description: Install the language server with pip automatically when it is missing, without prompting. Requires Python 3.10+ with pip.

pynescript.install.autoPrompt.description: Ask once whether to install the language server when it is missing and automatic install is off.

pynescript.install.package.markdownDescription: pip requirement installed by **PYNE: Install Language Server**.

pynescript.install.python.markdownDescription: Python interpreter used for `pip install` and as a fallback server launcher. Empty = `#pynescript.lsp.python#`, then `python3`, `python`, `py`.

pynescript.install.createVenv.description: Create an isolated virtualenv in extension storage when the system Python is externally managed (PEP 668).

pynescript.install.venv.description: Explicit virtualenv directory to create or reuse for the language server. Empty = automatic (extension storage) when needed.

pynescript.pro.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable PYNE Pro features such as **Run on Pro**. Requires `#pynescript.pro.apiKey#` and a reachable backend.

pynescript.pro.apiKey.markdownDescription: Pro API key minted with `POST /auth/create_key` on your Pro instance. Stored in VS Code settings in plain text.

pynescript.backend.url.markdownDescription: Self-hosted backend base URL without the `/run` suffix, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:5002`.

pynescript.backend.useHosted.markdownDescription: Use the hosted `pynescript.online` backend instead of `#pynescript.backend.url#`.

pynescript.backend.hostedUrl.markdownDescription: Hosted backend base URL used when `#pynescript.backend.useHosted#` is enabled.

pynescript.backend.package.markdownDescription: pip requirement installed by **PYNE: Install Backend (Pro API)**.

pynescript.backend.path.description: Path to a PYNE checkout containing `backend/app.py`, used by **PYNE: Start Backend**. Empty = first workspace folder.
